subject: Post-call: schedule tech deep dive & confirm attendees
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@healthspan.io>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@healthspan.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: schedule tech deep dive & confirm attendees

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Key goals you mentioned: integrate Redwood inference for in-app summarization and reduce per-token cost at scale.
- Main constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flow, require audit logs, and prefer VPC/private deployment for PII workflows.
- Success metrics: 20–30% latency reduction for short prompts and predictable monthly spend.

As discussed, next step is a 60-minute technical deep dive tailored to your infra and security questions. Proposed objective: walk through architecture options (hosted vs Private), data flow, and an SE-led demo on a sample summarization pipeline.

Please confirm:
1) Which internal HealthSpan attendees should join (roles preferred: infra/IT + product owner + security/compliance).
2) Which of these two windows works for you? 
   - Wed 26 Aug, 10:00 AM PT (preferred)
   - Thu 27 Aug, 2:00 PM PT

I’ve attached a short agenda and a draft mutual action plan to help scope the session. Once you confirm the slot and attendees I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and the meeting agenda.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-td-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@healthspan.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@healthspan.io>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: schedule tech deep dive & confirm attendees

Thanks Karthik — good recap. Wed 26 Aug 10:00 AM PT works for us. Attendees from HealthSpan:
- Samantha Reed (Product Lead)
- Tom Nguyen (Infrastructure/Platform)
- Priya Suresh (Security & Compliance)
- Dev team representative (TBD)

We want the session to:
- Validate VPC/on-prem options and audit logging.
- See a short demo of the summarization flow with token cost estimates.
- Get a checklist of what you’ll need from our side to run a pilot.

One ask: can your SE address basic network/setup questions (firewall, egress, KMS integration)? If Monica can cover that, great.

Also, we have a handful of pre-sales security items — I’ll send the list to Tom and Monica shortly so you can prep.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Reed | Product Lead, HealthSpan
samantha.reed@healthspan.io
